title: LeaveReleaseResult
description: Saga reply from Scheduling to Leave. data of scheduling.leave-release.completed.v1 (releasedAssignmentIds filled) and scheduling.leave-release.rejected.v1 (reason filled, nothing changed). aggregateId = leaveRequestId.

reason.description: Why the release was refused, e.g. an overlapping shift is LOCKED (starts within 24 h).
